descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division , you will play a critical role in ensuring that our operations and business interactions comply with all relevant requirements and internal Roche policies, and will also support the organization in day-to-day legal matters. As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division, you will be:
• Strategic Partner: Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the fulfillment of all Roche divisional and local requirements.
• Role Model: Serve as a role model in ethical behavior and decision-making, promoting a culture of integrity and compliance across the organization.
• Strategic Influence: Drive compliance integration into business processes and decision-making.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work proactively with various departments to help them achieve their business goals in compliance with Roche policies and guidelines.
• Culture Building: Lead the development and nurturing of a robust compliance culture within the Roche Latvia Pharma organization to ensure business processes align with legal requirements and internal policies. Legal support: support Roche Latvia Pharma organization and Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster with day to day legal matters, which includes legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, etc. Compliance support to Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Riga: you will extend, scale and apply compliance work done for Pharma also to the Roche Services & Solutions site in Riga (e.g. joint SOPs & training). Serve as Compliance Officer for RSS Riga and report to the Head of RSS Riga in this capacity. Key Compliance Responsibilities Under the oversight of and in collaboration with the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster, perform the following tasks in the Compliance Manager capacity:
• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.
• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.
• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.
• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.
• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.
• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.
• Promoting Compliance
